description: This file performs portfolio optimization, including data retrieval from Yahoo Finance, calculating returns, generating random portfolios, and optimizing for maximum Sharpe ratio and minimum variance. It also visualizes efficient frontiers and performs discrete allocation of assets.

methods.name: random_portfolios
methods.description: Generates random portfolio weights and calculates their performance metrics.

methods.name: neg_sharpe_ratio
methods.description: Calculates the negative Sharpe ratio for given weights.

methods.name: max_sharpe_ratio
methods.description: Finds the portfolio with the maximum Sharpe ratio.

methods.name: portfolio_performance
methods.description: Calculates annualized return and volatility of a portfolio based on weights.

methods.name: portfolio_volatility
methods.description: Calculates the volatility of a portfolio.

methods.name: min_variance
methods.description: Finds the portfolio with minimum variance.

methods.name: efficient_return
methods.description: Calculates the portfolio with a target return that minimizes volatility.

methods.name: efficient_frontier
methods.description: Constructs the efficient frontier over a range of returns.

methods.name: display_calculated_ef_with_random
methods.description: Visualizes random portfolios, maximum Sharpe, minimum variance, and efficient frontier.

methods.name: display_ef_with_selected
methods.description: Visualizes individual stock returns, volatility, and efficient frontier.
